policy: Candidates are selected from the confirmed 1120-page acceptance PDF. They are not HUMAN_VERIFIED Gold pages until page-image hashes, annotations, and reviewer sign-off are recorded.

candidates.reason: image-only opening page; exercises scanned/image path
regular text page with embedded image
low native-text density with multiple images
dense vocabulary content suitable for entry-boundary regression
dense vocabulary page near Word List transition
vocabulary entries with examples/collocations and page-boundary pressure

required_before_freeze: render candidate page images and record SHA256
inspect page visuals and finalize layout tags
create ground-truth annotation JSON per page
human reviewer sign-off for all 30 pages
